headline: Concord Enviro Systems Limited scheme of arrangement NCLT petition filed
sum: Concord Enviro Systems Limited filed a scheme of arrangement petition before the NCLT, with notice of hearing published in newspapers on 23 June 2026; details of transaction structure, counterparty and consideration remain undisclosed in publicly available filings.
implication: Scheme of arrangement petitions trigger mandatory NCLT jurisdictional review under the Companies Act 2013; counsel must monitor the NCLT order stage for detailed scheme terms, share exchange ratios, and any creditor or minority dissent procedures.
detail: The NSE archives contain a newspaper publication notice (dated 23 June 2026) relating to a hearing petition in a scheme of arrangement matter. The filing does not disclose the counterparty, transaction structure, consideration, or expected timeline. Concord Enviro Systems Limited is a water treatment and environmental services company. The scheme requires NCLT sanction under Companies Act s. 230–232, following which shareholder and creditor approval is needed, before final court order.
